image_description: A high-angle, close-up photograph of a tiger beetle resting on a textured, sandy surface. The beetle exhibits a metallic coppery-bronze coloration with distinct pale cream markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes, and long filiform antennae extend backward. Six slender legs are visible, gripping the substrate.
